what: It runs high-end Japanese-style restaurants in Hong Kong, currently two restaurants under four brand names.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about $17,281,044. It plans 6.3% to repay loans, 25.0% to expand restaurants, 30.0% for possible acquisitions, and 38.7% for working capital.
risks: It works in a very competitive Hong Kong restaurant market, and many rivals have more money, longer histories and stronger brands.
Its success depends on meeting customer expectations and keeping up with changing tastes through new menu items.
Its success depends on Japanese food staying popular in Hong Kong, and that popularity may fade.
Its growth depends on customers recognizing its brands, and factors outside its control could weaken them.
